app.name: neVus
app.tagline: Because 'I think it was smaller' is not data.
app.intendedUse: neVus is a personal documentation and measurement aid. It does not diagnose, screen for, or assess the risk of any disease.

auth.passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters. A sentence works well.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
auth.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords are not the same.
auth.claimIntro: Nobody has an account yet. The first account becomes the administrator and creates the others; there is no open registration.
auth.proxyText: This neVus signs people in through your single sign-on. Sign in there, then come back here.
auth.codeIntro: Enter the six-digit code from the authenticator app on your phone.
auth.recoveryIntro: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set the second factor up. Each works once.

persons.title: Persons
persons.name: Name
persons.emptyText: A person is somebody whose skin marks you keep a record of: you, or someone you look after.
persons.experimentalHint: Off by default. When on, neVus may propose outlines and changes on its own; each proposal is labelled experimental and you confirm or reject it.

images.uploaded: Saved. Location data and device identifiers were removed from the file.
images.privacyNote: The photo stays on this server. Everything the camera embedded except the capture time and orientation is removed before it is stored.
images.emptyTextEdit: Take the first photo of a mark, or choose one from the gallery.
images.emptyTextView: Nobody has added photos for this person yet.

bodymap.label: Body map, {{view}}
bodymap.title: Body map
bodymap.hint: Tap a zone to select it.

lesions.title: Marks
lesions.placingHint: Tap the zone where the mark is: the map zooms in on it. Then tap the exact spot.
lesions.placingSpot: Tap the exact spot of the mark in {{zone}}.
lesions.label: Name
lesions.labelHint: Optional. Otherwise the zone name is used.
lesions.emptyTextEdit: Add a mark by tapping its place on the body map.
lesions.emptyTextView: Nobody has added marks for this person yet.

observations.title: Visits
observations.emptyText: A visit is one dated look at the mark: photos, your notes and what you noticed.
observations.notesHint: What you noticed, in your own words. neVus records it and never interprets it.

quality.title: Saved with quality warnings
quality.hint: The visit is kept as it is. If you can, take the photo again.

flags.blurry: Blurry: hold the phone steady and tap the mark to focus.
flags.too_dark: Too dark: add light or move closer to a window.
flags.too_bright: Overexposed: avoid direct sunlight and the flash.
flags.glare: Glare: tilt the phone a little so reflections move off the mark.
flags.low_resolution: Low resolution: use the camera at full size rather than a screenshot or a forwarded copy.

measure.title: Measure
measure.canvasScale: Photo. Tap the coin or the ends of a known length.
measure.canvasMark: Photo. Tap the mark to outline it.
measure.zoomHint: Pinch or use the mouse wheel to zoom, drag to move. With a keyboard: + and − zoom, the arrows move, Enter places at the centre.
measure.cardTilted: Reference card found, but tilted {{tilt}}° (limit {{limit}}°). If you can, retake the photo holding the phone parallel to the skin.
measure.cardSmall: The card looks small: come closer next time.
measure.cardNotFound: No reference card in this photo. Use a coin or a length you know.
measure.coinAdjust: Drag the handles until the circle follows the coin's edge.
measure.coinTiltNote: A coin cannot show whether the phone was tilted, so the uncertainty is larger than with the card.
measure.lineTap_one: Tap one more end of the length.
measure.lineTap_other: Tap both ends of something whose length you know.
measure.lineAdjust: Drag the ends if needed and type the length.
measure.markAdjust: Check the outline. Switch to a circle to adjust it by hand.

flags.tilted: The photo is tilted beyond {{limit}}°: this measurement is kept but flagged.
flags.unverified_card: The card's print size is not verified (Settings, Reference card), so the uncertainty is larger.
flags.tilt_unknown: Camera tilt is unknown with a coin or a length; hold the phone parallel to the skin.

measure.disclaimer: A measurement describes size. It says nothing about what the mark is.
measure.noneYet: No measurements for this visit yet.
measure.needPhoto: Add a photo to measure the mark.

card.title: Reference card
card.intro: Print it, cut it out and place its window over the mark when you take a photo: neVus reads the scale and the tilt from it.
card.lineLabel: Measured length of the 50 mm line
card.lineHint: After printing, measure the line with a ruler and type what you read (for example 49.6).
card.verified: Print verified: the line measured {{mm}} mm.
card.unverified: Not verified yet: measurements made with the card carry a larger uncertainty.

reminders.title: Due for a photo
reminders.settingsIntro: Marks due for a photo appear on the home page. You can also receive one email a day when something is due; it lists names and dates, never photos.
reminders.emailReminders: Send me a daily email when marks are due
reminders.needEmail: Add an email address to turn email reminders on.

admin.emailIntro: The mail server neVus uses to send reminders. Nothing is sent until this is filled in and people turn reminders on.
admin.passwordKept: A password is stored. Leave this empty to keep it.
admin.publicUrlHint: Used for the link in emails, for example https://nevus.example.home
admin.evaluationLink: Evaluation set: label your photos to measure the analyzers

sudo.title: Confirm it is you
sudo.intro: This action needs your password again.
sudo.introProxy: This action cannot be undone easily. Confirm that you want to go ahead.

trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Deleted marks, visits and photos stay here for 30 days, then go for good.
trash.emptyText: What you delete stays here for a while in case you change your mind.

data.title: Your data
data.intro: Take everything with you as one encrypted file, or recover what you deleted.
data.exportIntro: Choose a passphrase. You will need it to open the file; neVus does not keep it, so nobody can recover the file without it. It opens with the standard age tool.
data.exportStarted: The export is being prepared. It appears under Settings, Your data.
data.overQuota: This person's photos use more space than the limit the administrator set. Nothing is refused; consider removing old duplicates.
data.purgeIntro: Every mark, visit, measurement and photo of {{name}} will be removed now, without passing through the trash. Export first if you want to keep a copy.

offline.waiting_one: One visit is waiting to upload.
offline.quickIntro: No connection. Take the photos now: the visit is kept on this device and uploads by itself when you are back online.
offline.saved: Kept on this device. It will upload when the connection is back.

capture.title: Live camera
capture.error: The camera could not start: {{message}}. Use Take a photo instead.
capture.lastTime: Last time: try to match the distance and the angle.

compare.title: Compare
compare.needTwo: Comparing needs photos from two visits, or two photos of one visit.
compare.samePhoto: Both sides show the same photo. Choose another one for one of them.
compare.alignedCard: Lined up with the reference card in both photos.
compare.alignedPoints: Lined up using {{count}} points the two photos have in common.
compare.abstained: These photos could not be lined up reliably, so only side by side is offered.
compare.abstainedHint: For the other views, take the photos with the reference card, or from a similar distance and angle.

reasons.too_little_detail: There is too little detail to match.
reasons.too_few_matches: They have too few points in common.
reasons.no_consistent_alignment: No single way to line them up fits.
reasons.matches_disagree: The points in common do not agree with each other.
reasons.mirrored: One photo would have to be mirrored.
reasons.distance: They were taken from very different distances.
reasons.angle: They were taken from very different angles.

compare.canvas: {{photo}}. Zoom and pan are shared with the other photo.
compare.opacity: How much of the later photo shows
compare.differenceNote: Shaded where the colours differ once the photos are lined up. It shows where to look and measures nothing: light, focus and hair show up here too.
compare.zoomHint: Pinch or use the mouse wheel to zoom, drag to move; side by side, both photos follow. With a keyboard: + and − zoom, the arrows move.

chart.title: Size over time
chart.subtitle: At each visit.
chart.subtitleBand: At each visit. The shaded band is the measurement uncertainty.
chart.label: {{metric}} at {{count}} visits. Use the arrow keys to go through them.

reports.title: Reports
reports.introProfile: A PDF summary of every mark, with the body map and the latest sizes, to take to a consultation.
reports.introLesion: A PDF record of this mark for the clinician: its photos with a scale, the measurements with their uncertainty, and your notes.
reports.makeLesion: Make the record of this mark
reports.deletedMark: a mark that is no longer here
reports.whatSelection: the marks I choose, with their records

appointments.intro: Planning to see a clinician? Enter the date: neVus lists the marks to photograph before it and makes the report to bring.
appointments.title: Appointment on {{date}}
appointments.edit: Change the date or the note
appointments.allDone: Every mark on the list has a new photo.
appointments.reportIntro: The summary of every mark, then the record of each mark on the list, to print or send.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: Send the daily list of marks due for a photo to Home Assistant, ntfy, Gotify, n8n or any address. Each webhook covers the persons you own or manage, and carries names and dates only, never photos or notes.
webhooks.name: Name (optional)

urlHints.home_assistant: The webhook address of an automation's trigger, such as https://ha.example/api/webhook/…
urlHints.ntfy: The topic address, such as https://ntfy.example/my-topic
urlHints.gotify: The server address, such as https://gotify.example
urlHints.n8n: The production address of a Webhook node
urlHints.generic: Receives a JSON POST with the list of due marks.

secretHints.home_assistant: If set, the JSON is signed in the X-Nevus-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256).
secretHints.ntfy: An access token, if the topic is protected.
secretHints.n8n: If set, the JSON is signed in the X-Nevus-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256).
secretHints.generic: If set, the JSON is signed in the X-Nevus-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256).

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.intro: Subscribe from your calendar app to see when each mark is due for a photo, and the appointments. The calendar reminds you on the day; it works over your VPN, with no push service.
calendar.warning: This link is shown only now. Anyone with it sees the names of the marks and their dates, so keep it private. Making a new link stops this one.
calendar.exists: A calendar link exists since {{date}}. To see it again, make a new one.

proposals.title: Proposed measurements
proposals.intro: Made by the experimental analysis turned on for this person. A proposal enters the record only if you use it; you can adjust it first or reject it.
proposals.noScale: No scale on this photo yet: adjust it to choose one.
proposals.nothing: The experimental analysis found no outline it could trust on a photo: {{reason}}

reasons.no_mark_found: nothing stood out from the skin.
reasons.low_contrast: the mark differs too little from the skin around it.
reasons.irregular_region: the region it found was too ragged.
reasons.too_large: the region it found was too large to be one mark.
reasons.too_small: the region it found was too small.

framing.mark_off_centre: put the mark in the middle of the frame.
framing.mark_small: come closer, so the mark fills more of the photo.
framing.mark_cut: keep the whole mark inside the frame.

evaluation.title: Evaluation set
evaluation.intro: Label your own photos to see how the analyzers do on them: draw the mark's true outline and say whether the photo is good. The labels stay on this server.
evaluation.caption: {{name}} {{version}} against your labels, per skin tone
evaluation.quality: Quality warnings agree with your judgement on {{agreement}} of the photos: {{caught}} of {{poor}} poor photos were warned about, and {{flagged}} of {{good}} good ones.
evaluation.command: These figures use the proposals already made. To run the current analyzer afresh on every labelled photo: nevus evaluate.
evaluation.labelIntro: Outline the mark as it really is. Tap it to fit an outline, or place the points yourself; the dashed line is the analyzer's proposal.
evaluation.canvasTap: Photo. Tap the mark to fit its outline.
evaluation.canvasPoints: Photo. Each tap adds a point of the outline.
evaluation.legend: Dashed: the analyzer's proposal. Solid: your label.
evaluation.qualityQuestion: Is this photo good enough to measure the mark?

sessions.title: Full-body sessions
sessions.intro: A session photographs the whole body region by region, in the same order and pose each time, so two sessions can be compared zone by zone. Skip any region you prefer not to photograph.
sessions.howTo: Use the same light and distance each time. Someone can help with the back, or prop the phone up and use its timer.
sessions.experimentalNote: The experimental analysis is on for this person: after each photo, spots that may be marks are proposed for you to confirm or reject. None is recorded unless you confirm it.
sessions.sensitive: This region may include intimate areas. Skip it if you prefer; nothing else depends on it.
sessions.analysing: Looking for spots on the photo…
sessions.deleteConfirm: Delete this session? Its photos go to the trash and the marks found on them are removed from it. The marks themselves stay in the registry.
sessions.markHint: Tap the photo where a mark is, then link it to a mark you already follow or record it as a new one.
sessions.markHintView: The marks seen on this photo.
sessions.noPhoto: This region has no photo in this session.
sessions.proposedUncertain: Proposed: {{name}} should be here, but no clear spot was found
sessions.proposedNew: Proposed: a spot not linked to any mark
sessions.newMarkZone: Or record a new mark in
sessions.cropAlt: The mark and the skin around it
sessions.compareNone: The two sessions have no region photographed in both.

face.name: Face
face.pose: Face the camera with your hair held back, so the whole face, the ears and the neck are in the frame.

scalp.name: Scalp
scalp.pose: Bow your head while someone parts the hair, and photograph the top and the back of the head.

chest.name: Chest and shoulders
chest.pose: Stand facing the camera, arms relaxed at your sides. Frame from the chin to the bottom of the ribs.

abdomen.name: Abdomen and pelvis
abdomen.pose: Stand facing the camera. Frame from the bottom of the ribs to the top of the thighs.

upper-back.name: Upper back
upper-back.pose: Stand with your back to the camera, arms relaxed. Frame from the neck to the bottom of the shoulder blades.

lower-back.name: Lower back and buttocks
lower-back.pose: Stand with your back to the camera. Frame from the bottom of the shoulder blades to the top of the thighs.

right-arm-front.name: Right arm, front
right-arm-front.pose: Hold the right arm out to the side, palm forward. Frame from the shoulder to the wrist.

left-arm-front.name: Left arm, front
left-arm-front.pose: Hold the left arm out to the side, palm forward. Frame from the shoulder to the wrist.

right-arm-back.name: Right arm, back
right-arm-back.pose: Hold the right arm out to the side, palm back. Frame from the shoulder to the wrist, the elbow included.

left-arm-back.name: Left arm, back
left-arm-back.pose: Hold the left arm out to the side, palm back. Frame from the shoulder to the wrist, the elbow included.

palms.name: Palms
palms.pose: Lay both hands side by side, palms up, fingers apart.

backs-of-hands.name: Backs of the hands
backs-of-hands.pose: Lay both hands side by side, palms down, fingers apart.

right-leg-front.name: Right leg, front
right-leg-front.pose: Stand facing the camera. Frame the right leg from the hip to the ankle.

left-leg-front.name: Left leg, front
left-leg-front.pose: Stand facing the camera. Frame the left leg from the hip to the ankle.

right-leg-back.name: Right leg, back
right-leg-back.pose: Stand with your back to the camera. Frame the right leg from the buttock to the heel.

left-leg-back.name: Left leg, back
left-leg-back.pose: Stand with your back to the camera. Frame the left leg from the buttock to the heel.

tops-of-feet.name: Tops of the feet
tops-of-feet.pose: Stand with the feet slightly apart and photograph them from above, the ankles included.

soles.name: Soles
soles.pose: Sit or kneel and show both soles to the camera, the heels included.

sessions.blur: Blur a part of the photo
sessions.blurHint: Tap two opposite corners of the area to blur. Add as many areas as you need, then apply.
sessions.blurNote: The blurred photo takes this one's place. The original is removed at once, not kept in the trash, and cannot be brought back; the marks on the photo stay.

secondFactor.title: Second factor
secondFactor.intro: With a second factor, signing in needs your password and a code from an authenticator app on your phone, so a password alone opens nothing.
secondFactor.on_one: The second factor is on. {{count}} recovery code left.
secondFactor.on_other: The second factor is on. {{count}} recovery codes left.
secondFactor.step1: Open an authenticator app (any that handles time-based codes) and add an account.
secondFactor.step2: Scan this code with it, or type the letters below.
secondFactor.step3: Enter the six-digit code the app shows, then save the recovery codes it gives you here.
secondFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app; the same secret is written out below it
secondFactor.codesIntro: Each of these signs you in once if the phone is lost. Save them somewhere safe now: they are not shown again.

accounts.title: Accounts (administrator)
accounts.intro: Who can sign in to this neVus. There is no open registration: you create each account with a temporary password, which the person changes in their settings.
accounts.introProxy: Who can sign in to this neVus. Accounts come from your single sign-on; here you can only disable one.
accounts.resetSecondFactorNamed: Turn the second factor off for {{name}}
accounts.secondFactorReset: The second factor is off for that account; the password still works.
accounts.passwordSet: The password is set. Tell the person, and ask them to change it.
accounts.temporaryHint: At least {{count}} characters. The person changes it after signing in.

backups.title: Backups (administrator)
backups.off: Nightly backups are off. Set NEVUS_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE on the server to turn them on; the deployment guide explains how.
backups.intro: An encrypted backup is written every night after {{hour}}:00 into the backups folder of the data directory. Copy that folder to another machine: a backup on the same disk does not survive the disk.
backups.verifyEvery_one: Every day the latest backup is read back to prove it would restore.
backups.verifyEvery_other: Every {{count}} days the latest backup is read back to prove it would restore.
backups.verifyNever: Reading backups back is turned off (NEVUS_BACKUP_VERIFY_DAYS is 0).
backups.none: No backup has been written yet.
backups.verifiedOk: Read back on {{date}}: {{archive}} would restore ({{count}} files checked).
backups.neverVerified: No backup has been read back yet.
backups.verifyNow: Read the latest backup back now

problems.no_backup: There is no backup to read.
problems.unreadable: The archive could not be read: a wrong passphrase or a damaged file.
problems.damaged_blobs: Some photographs in the archive do not match their checksums.
problems.no_secret: The server secret is missing from the archive.
problems.no_database: The database copy is missing from the archive.
problems.database_integrity: The database copy fails SQLite's integrity check.
problems.missing_blobs: Photographs the database refers to are missing from the archive.
problems.live_store: Files in the live store are missing or damaged.
